working_context.mission: Build a zero-copy event router with governed single-writer state projection.
working_context.active_objective: Add async external webhook dispatch without violating zero-copy ring buffer lifetimes.

accepted_decisions.statement: RingBuffer slices ('buf) must never cross async await boundaries; clone into OwnedProposal first.

hard_constraints: SPRITE state projection is single-writer; workers may only emit OwnedProposal.
Zero-copy RingBuffer cannot be locked across network I/O.
open_questions: Should retry backoff live in router.rs or a dedicated async dispatcher worker?

declared_project_rules: INVARIANT: Wire frames use big-endian length prefixes and CRC32C trailers.
INVARIANT: RuntimeConfig is immutable after engine bootstrap.
INVARIANT: RingBuffer owns the underlying arena; slices tied to 'buf cannot outlive a single poll cycle.
CANONICAL RULE: Only StateProjector::apply_verified may mutate canonical state snapshots.
INVARIANT: RouteHandler::handle executes synchronously inside the hot ring-buffer loop.
CONTRACT: Must not hold RawFrame<'buf> across async suspension points.
RULE: Telemetry spans must never include raw payload bytes or secret tokens.
INVARIANT: Audit worker is read-only and must never write directly to StateProjector.
CONTRACT: Verifies OwnedProposal digests before archival.
